prompt: Sites want link cards to credit their X (Twitter) account. Add an optional `twitterSite` member to `PublicRoutesConfig`, the config `createPublicRoutes` takes: a handle such as "@trailcrew" that every entry page's SEO head then carries as a `twitter:site` meta tag. judge.text: The new option's contract is recorded where this tree's own option gate requires it: either a `PublicRoutesConfig.twitterSite` row in docs/internal/option-map.json pointing at a reference-page anchor whose section names `twitterSite` in inline code, or (on a tree whose gate reads TSDoc instead) a TSDoc comment on the member carrying the tier tag that gate requires; an `exclude` or `pending` row does not count.
A unit test asserts both that the SEO head carries a `twitter:site` meta tag with the configured handle and that no `twitter:site` tag appears when `twitterSite` is unset.

The tag reaches every entry's head, an undated page included, because composeEntryData forwards the option to buildSeoMeta unconditionally rather than only for dated entries the way it forwards `feeds`.
CHANGELOG.md's `## Unreleased` section gains an entry that names `twitterSite` as an added, optional `PublicRoutesConfig` member.
